artifactPolicy.reason: The locally compiled artifact incorporates GPL-licensed upstream source and must remain outside this proprietary repository.

derivation.why: The first fixture gave the labelled truth the FEWEST update functions (health 3) while upstream gives it the MOST (21), which inverted the one quantity that survives verification. It measured the fixture, not the model.
derivation.breadthRule: Per-pool function count = number of distinct upstream functions that update that pool in the pinned commit, by one grep rule over apps/ and components/: matches on `setHealth(` / `getHealth().setCurrent(` / `setDynamic(0,` for health, and the analogous patterns for magicka (1) and fatigue (2).
derivation.comparisonPools: The two pools that do not exist upstream in this form (shield, poison) take the MEDIAN of the three real counts (18), so the comparison is neither stacked for nor against the labelled truth.
derivation.mixRule: Every pool uses the same 2:1 decrement/increment mix, so the only per-pool difference is how many functions touch it.
derivation.abandonedFixture: The earlier symmetric 5-pool wrapper (health 3 / magicka 4 / fatigue 5 / shield 4 / poison 4 functions) produced deterministic rank 5 for the truth and no rescue. It is retained only as the counter-example that exposed the inversion.

compiler.note: The entry symbol must be passed as `__start` (the stored Mach-O name for the C symbol `_start`).

openJevContract.note: Verified against the live service. The only offered model is `openjev` (GET https://api.openjev.sh/v1/models); an `openjev-0.1` request returns 422. `api.codiv.ai` rejects this key with 401. `noul` requires `true`/`false` criteria and answers with a scalar `noul` = P(true).

objectLayout.note: Measured from the pinned stat.hpp layout and confirmed by the candidate set the scanner finds. Positions are byte offsets of DynamicStat<int>::mCurrent.

policies.note: Frozen in the labelled fixture, not in the harness code: a promotion decision must be bound to the exact policy identity it was measured with.

cases.note: The labelled truth is rank 1 on the breadth-faithful fixture: the deterministic model already answers this goal, so the referee has no scenario to act on.

Rank 2 and already verified by the baseline; it loses to health only because health has more upstream update functions. Rank 2 is inside the ordinary verification set, so the boundary referee again has nothing to add.

observed.finding: The ambiguity gate fires on this case (gap 0 <= 0.02) even though the top-1 is already the labelled truth and the wrong candidates are not reachable from the boundary set. On a breadth-faithful fixture the referee can therefore only be neutral or harmful, never corrective.
observed.verifiedCandidateProbabilities: All four verified candidates tie at p=0.982155; ordering decides, and breadth now puts the truth first.
observed.oldFixtureResult: On the inverted fixture the truth sat at rank 5 and neither choice, parallel noul, nor a forced oracle challenger changed the final top-1.

scope: Source-grounded compiler fixture only. It is not a full OpenMW release binary and cannot by itself authorize production promotion. The breadth-faithful fixture removes the referee's target scenario rather than enabling it, so production stays gated.
